text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити has been training hard every
day for
our next goal race, the Satsuki
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Pant... pant...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
choice_data_list: Good work. Let's take a break!

text_block_list.text: ...Already?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I can keep going. Why are you being so
easy on
me?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Push me harder. I have to be so much
better than
I am now!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: I am patient.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I'm going to cool down! I'll be back
soon!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Sigh... What am I, a little kid throwing a tantrum?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Hey!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
What're ya doin' wanderin' onto the
track?
Don'tcha know that's a hazard?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Sorry! I must've spaced out.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Dang it, well be careful!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: ...Guess I should go back.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Raaaaahhhh!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... Tch, I'm not gettin' faster at all. Again!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: What insane energy...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Um... Tamamo! Can I...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since City ran off. I
decide to
check on her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Haaaaahh!
Raaaahhh!
text_block_list.name: City and Tamamo

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити is having an intense pair
running
session with Тамамо Кросс!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Woo! Dat's what I'm talkin' about!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Damn it, I was so close!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Ey, but ya did good. Nothin' like having
a rival to
get ya fired up!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Sounds like you can go for more. How
about
another lap?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Huh... So you ran away durin' your break
and
wandered over here.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
No wonder your trainer looks like a sad
puppy.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
It's not that I don't respect what my
trainer says...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
But I can't afford to take a break. I have
to push
my limits and get faster!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Well, can't say I don't know how ya feel.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
But that's no reason to skip out on
breaks. For
such a pretty face, you're
really bullheaded.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
What does being pretty have to do with

anything?!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: My bad.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Uh...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
We all got things we don't wanna be
told, even if
they're compliments.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
People used to make funna me, callin'
me short all
the time.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
But that doesn't matter here. I'm sorry if
I made
ya feel bad.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: I'm... sorry for overreacting.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: I know you actually care more about how I run.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Okay... Sorry for bothering you. But if
it's all right
with you, maybe we could—
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Hey, City. Can I ask ya one thing?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Why do ya run?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: ...Isn't it obvious?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: To make people accept who I am... to show them who I am!
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Flames burn in City's icy blue eyes.
Тамамо Кросс
responds...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Haha! Go get 'em! I knew there was
somethin'
special about you!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: See, the reason I run is to win. I gotta win to help out my family, and nobody can stand in my way!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
But no one's recognized me yet. I gotta
let
everyone know I'm here, just like you!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
The two look at each other silently with
measured
smiles.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'mma head on back. You
take a little
breather though, yeah?
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Tamamo! Are you going to compete in
the
Classics?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: I want to race against you.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I debuted pretty late, ya know? I'm
still... adjustin'
to things.
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text:
Tell ya this, though, if we do meet on
the track,
I'm gonna beat ya for real. Be
prepared!
text_block_list.name: Тамамо Кросс

text_block_list.text: Huh? That's my line.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling Голд Сити's interaction
with
Тамамо Кросс today will contribute
to her
growth.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
